dimension_c_md.title: Webhook trigger node has onError:continueRegularOutput — not in any sub-plan; violates error-handling design rule
dimension_c_md.evidence: WF-10.md diff hunk at line 357+: `{"onError":"continueRegularOutput"}` added to the Webhook node (Slack Events API entry point). sub-6b.md n8n edit plan lists node_additions/modifications/removals all empty (no n8n edits). sub-6a scope was 'envelopes only'. CLAUDE.md Design Rule: 'Do NOT add error handling beyond the entry guard pattern.' The Webhook trigger's continueRegularOutput means that if the trigger itself errors, execution silently continues — this could swallow Slack signature verification failures or malformed webhook bodies instead of returning a 4xx to Slack. No sprint doc (sub-6a, sub-6b, design.md §2.2) authorizes this.
dimension_c_md.recommended_action: Confirm whether this change was intentional (perhaps added manually outside sprint scope) or an accidental Wave-1 subagent side-effect. If unintentional, remove onError from the Webhook node. If intentional (e.g. to prevent Slack retry storms), add a note in state.md with rationale and cross-reference sub-6a.

questions_for_human: Q1 (Webhook onError): The Webhook trigger node in WF-10 now has onError:continueRegularOutput — this was not in sub-6a or sub-6b plans and appears to violate the no-extra-error-handling design rule. Was this added intentionally (e.g. to prevent Slack retry loops on transient errors)? If yes, it should be documented. If no, it should be reverted.

Q2 (slack_channel_id in Command Envelope): state.md followup #2 documents that the Load User Status SELECT is missing current_consultation_id and slack_channel_id. The pseudo's Step 23a acknowledges current_consultation_id being emitted as null, but Step 22 does NOT mention that slack_channel_id will also be null in the Command Envelope user object. Should followup #2 be updated to explicitly name both missing columns, and should Step 22 prose be patched to match Step 23a's documented-null pattern?
